my_lead: 3ea - abstract: 'identified the compound 3ea as a potent and efficacious PAM', used in PK and mouse PPI experiments

reactions.issue: 4a from 2-chloro-6-methylaniline + chloroacetyl chloride (100 mmol / 150 mmol); NaOAc/AcOH is base/solvent, correctly omitted. SMILES correct.

Procedure: 4a + K2[NCN=CS2] + NaOH (Thorpe-Ziegler) then benzyl bromide, crude 10a isolated. All three molecules incorporated and listed. 10a SMILES (4-amino-2-benzylthio-thiazole-5-carboxanilide) is right. But it is a one-pot, two-operation step that Scheme 4 labels (a) and (b) separately; counting them separately gives 4 steps, still within the limit.

10a + HCOOH reflux 1 h, 75%. Formic acid supplies the C5-H of the pyrimidinone, so listing it is correct (origin 'reagent' rather than 'commercial' is fine, but it is a real reactant). Product SMILES: thiazolo[4,5-d]pyrimidin-7(6H)-one numbering checked, N6-aryl, 2-SBn correct.

leaf_issues: The 3ea procedure says 'Compound 5a (1.10 g, 5 mmol)'; 5a is not defined anywhere, the amount matches 4a (MW 218), so the transcriber's use of 4a is right but the paper has this typo.

All four leaves rest only on the general sentence 'Commercial reagents were purchased from Ouhe, Aladdin, and J&K Scientific'; dipotassium cyanodithioimidocarbonate and benzyl bromide are not individually named, but nothing is prepared for them.
notes: Route stands (3 steps, target = lead 3ea, no stereo). Edit/flag: (1) step 2 merges two Scheme-4 steps (a: cyclisation, b: S-alkylation) into one with an isolated crude 10a, say so; (2) 'compound 5a' typo in the 3ea procedure; (3) formic acid is an atom-supplying reactant (kept). Supporting sentence: 'Commercial reagents were purchased from Ouhe, Aladdin, and J&K Scientific and used without further purification.'
